description: Source code for TinyMCE's template plugin, defining plugin information, initialization, command execution, node handling, and template processing functions.

classes.name: TinyMCE_TemplatePlugin
classes.description: Object containing functions and properties for the TinyMCE template plugin.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata including name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance with configuration, classes, and shortcut keys.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for the plugin control button.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands such as inserting or updating templates.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles node selection changes within the editor.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up template content for different editor operations.

methods.name: _convertToNode
methods.description: Converts HTML string to DOM node.

methods.name: _prepareTemplateContent
methods.description: Prepares template content by processing DOM nodes.

methods.name: _replaceValues
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in template strings with actual values.

methods.name: _applyFunctions
methods.description: Applies class-based functions to DOM elements.

methods.name: _collectTemplateElements
methods.description: Collects template elements from a node.

methods.name: _replaceTemplateContent
methods.description: Replaces current template content with new content.

methods.name: _deleteTemplateContent
methods.description: Removes existing template content from DOM.

methods.name: _insertTemplate
methods.description: Inserts a new template into the editor.

methods.name: functions
methods.description: Object containing helper functions for date formatting, content handling, and class-based function execution.

methods.name: _getDateTime
methods.description: Formats date/time according to specified format.
